record.hypothesis: (a1) On real SubPipe cam0 frames the engineered ECMER quality features respond in the physically expected direction to controlled blur / noise / darkening, and the ECMER encoder yields finite contract-valid Evidence. (a2) A logistic probe on ECMER evidence (256-d event embedding, randomly initialised encoder) predicts the dataset's side-scan-sonar "Pipeline" presence label on held-out time blocks better than the trivial majority baseline.
limitations: single mission: held-out time blocks of one survey, not an independent sequence or site
labels are human 'Pipeline' boxes on colormapped side-scan images; presence only, no structural condition
ECMER weights are random (untrained); a probe on random features tests information retention, not a trained ECMER
sonar images are colormapped PPM renderings (TVG/normalisation applied by the dataset), not raw backscatter
this archive (SubPipeMiniSSS) contains no RGB segmentation masks; camera frames are unlabelled

(b) Model2S not run: EstimatedState is the vehicle's own navigation estimate with undocumented frame conventions (not ground truth), and the side-scan/DVL mount geometry needed for range integration is not published
